_comment: The `policy-codex` world — `policy-default` plus the codex rail (specs/worlds/README.md), for the GW-RAIL-CODEX / GW-CODEX-HEADROOM / GW-CODEX-OAUTH / codex GW-SESSIONS-ENV rows ONLY. The DEPLOYED policy declares no codex rail (the rail ships dark). The codex model id is a FIXTURE name (`codex/fixture-model` → wire `fixture-model`, the name experiments/codex-rail/compat.py uses): model-classes.json runs no codex model, and choosing a representative one is not a fixture's call. `prober` alone may ride codex, after anthropic (the spike's prober-only canary shape, docs/spikes/codex-subscription-rail.md); only `harness: codex` speaks the rail's `responses` dialect, so no other harness ever lands on it. `headroom` = the experiment's fixture profile (120 s freshness, 0.95 ceiling, the 300/10080-minute windows) and `oauth.refresh_margin_s` = its 30 s — adopted as fixture values, not as production policy (⚖ GW-CODEX-HEADROOM).

admission._comment: ⚖ the old proxy's values, copied (sessions.md §Capacity): utilization_thresholds 5h = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (openrouter-proxy.py; unset in its deployment.yaml), 7d = ANTHROPIC_UTIL_THRESHOLD_7D 0.95 (deployment.yaml); latch_429_hold_s = ANTHROPIC_429_HOLD_S 900. reading_stale_s 900 has NO old-proxy precedent (it only drops a reading whose reset passed) — the gateway's own guess, ⚖.

Rules only (GW-CATALOG-GO, operator ruling 5, 2026-10-17): prices, peak rows and hours, per-model monthly limits and the window shares come from the Go catalog snapshot, never from here. latch_429_hold_s = openrouter-proxy.py GO_CAPACITY_HOLD_S 900: the hold a Go 429 that names no reset cools its CELL for; latch_scope model = a Go 429 never latches the whole rail (ruling 3: each model has its own limits). windows: the anchors are gometer _GO_WINDOW_DEFAULTS (chain / weekly mon 00:00 / monthly 13 11:30 — self-measured, no vendor source; GO_WINDOW_ANCHORS unset in deployment.yaml), threshold = OPENCODE_UTIL_THRESHOLD's code default 0.80 (unset in deployment.yaml).

context_tokens._comment: per-model harness window — the Go rail's deepseek-v4.1-flash = the console /api/v2/config `limit.context` (2026-10-17), as in the deployed policy; absent = null in the dispatch answer, never a guess.

callers._comment: GW-SESSIONS-AUTH — fixture identities (specs/worlds/README.md): the platform loop's dispatcher (worker admissions bound into its fixture worker namespace) and the specs reviewer's tick (reviewer + the worker-role shadow cell, never a bind), and a JUDGE (GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME: admits nothing, `outcome: any` — may report an outcome on any platform session). `observe` here: a caller with no token is admitted and counted, as in `policy-default`.
